summary: PAUSE badge fixes verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass against the live preview — GET /api/category-media/{id}?v=holo-v1&delivery=holo-v1j&cutout=true&cut=2&tight=true returns 200 for all 10 required ids (animali, scienza, cultura, spazio, natura, storia, tecnologia, psicologia, corpo-umano, geografia); every PNG is RGBA with height > 180 (cultura 320×238 confirmed → mirror-cut heuristic did NOT destroy it); every PNG's bottom row has max alpha = 0 → no shadow/mirror residue baked into the asset. Frontend: measured the DOM on the Home discover card — kind icon = 32×32, time icon = 32×32, CATEGORY icon = 30×23 (~28% shorter than kind/time, well within the 'at least 15% smaller' request). Verified 4 real categories (Animals/paw, Nature/leaf, Space/planet, Culture/book) via close-up screenshots: the pixels directly below each category icon match the surrounding badge background — no shadow, no mirror, no soft halo visible on any of them. Culture (previously the broken one) renders perfectly. The 3 cells still align, no clipping, no icon↔text overlap. The reader-ending BadgeIcons component uses the identical CategoryArtMark with size=23 and the same cutout URL, so the same clean asset is served there by construction (couldn't tap into the reader during this run but the backend pytest covers that path).
critical_code_review_comments: story-info-grid.tsx line 105: iconWrap width was shrunk from 36→32 px and CATEGORY size from 27→23 px (~15% smaller). Category image at render is 30×23 (23 × 1.3 aspect) inside the 32-wide wrap → 2 px breathing room horizontally, matches the comment on line 103. Fine.

media_opt.cutout_png: the 4-pass pipeline (flood-fill tol=90 → hard alpha threshold at 160/200 → dark-pixel sweep in bottom 45% → disconnected-mirror-blob detector gated by mass > 2% above AND content-below < 50% of content-above) is well-commented and defensive. The 2%-mass gate is what saved cultura from the previous destructive cut; keep it.

Reader-ending BadgeIcons duplicates the three-icon layout logic of StoryInfoGrid (lines 64-92 vs story-info-grid lines 55-74). Not a bug, but a candidate for a shared primitive if the design changes again.

Non-blocking: console still logs 'textShadow* style props are deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — RN 0.75+ deprecations, unrelated to this task but worth cleaning up in a maintenance pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest flow: Continue as guest → the topic grid shows ENGLISH labels (Science/Space/Animals/Culture/Nature/Human Body/…). Tap ≥1 chip, then 'Start discovering'. On the Home card the badge is testID='home-story-meta' with children '-kind-icon', '-category-icon', '-time-icon'. The category icon has src .../api/category-media/{id}?cutout=true&cut=2&tight=true&delivery=holo-v1j — pulling this URL directly and checking bottom-row alpha=0 is the fastest regression test for the mirror/shadow fix. To reach reader-ending, tap a visible story title (locator by text, not by testID — 'home-story-title' did not exist in this build) and scroll down. The reader badge is testID='next-badge-icons' once visible. Current card measurements: kind 32×32, category 30×23, time 32×32.
rca_of_issue: N/A — verification task. Pixel-level evidence: cultura cutout returned 320×238 RGBA (vs the previous destructive 6×6 regression), confirming the 'object mass above the gap > 2%' guard in media_opt.cutout_png line 107 protects multi-part icons; mirror-detector only cuts when 'content below first empty row' < 50% of 'content above' (line 109). Bottom-row alpha=0 across all 10 tested categories confirms the third pass (lines 79-86, bottom-half partial-alpha wipe) kills the mirror halo without touching the top-half object. Frontend size change validated: category height 23 px vs kind/time 32 px = 71.9% → category is 28% smaller than the siblings, exceeding the requested ~15% reduction and matching the user's visual expectation.
